gpu_selection: three observations; prioritize free memory, then utilization; shared GPU authorized
scheduler: linear warmup followed by cosine to 0.1 peak over 5 epochs
train_reduction: valid-scalar-weighted microbatch objectives, accumulated to 256 windows; Corr is per microbatch
validation_selection: complete-trial equal average of branch objective
force_label_preprocessing: native CMCU/BSQ units and timestamps; no extra force lowpass, MA7, clipping or post-hoc time shifting
calibration: all eligible complete presses of nearest whole test5; test5 includes itself, other stages use absolute-nearest test5; in-domain PAVA; no silent bad-source fallback
scoring: all eligible target presses; own complete test5 curve for test5, nearest test5 for ordinary stages/test7; common in-domain/finite/sync/EMG-valid mask across experiments
gpu_memory_policy: per-process ceiling=min(32 GiB, round_down_to_4GiB(observed_free_GiB-4GiB external reserve-2GiB CUDA overhead))
nearest_source: test5 itself for test5; otherwise minimum absolute recording-center distance within same subject/date/PC/boot, before or after
evaluation_scope: Person-disjoint model evaluation with provided offline per-record calibration. Test5 uses its own complete calibration and test7 uses same-person nearest test5. No held-out person enters training or normalization.
gross_calibration_rejection: source-fit absolute residual P90 >10 N AND >50% fitted force span; calibration-only fixed rule before formal training
initialization: common seed-42 random initialization from exact K2-5p56M architecture; no pretraining
